usageNotes: Triggers an async re-scan of pending package updates across all configured PDM remotes. Returns a UPID that must be polled for completion before the refreshed data is available. The caller needs Resource.Modify on /resource/{remote} for each remote that should be included in the refresh.

examples.summary: Trigger an update-summary refresh for all remotes

tips: No body parameters are accepted; send an empty JSON object ({}) or omit the body.
Poll the returned UPID via the PDM tasks API to determine when the refresh completes before querying update summaries.
Remotes that are offline or unreachable at refresh time will simply not update; no error is raised for individual failures.
